backend/main.mo: Main actor that includes blob storage mixin and defines Nakshatra type with fields for name, imageUrl, description, rulingDeity, symbol, and characteristics. Initializes a map with data for all 27 nakshatras.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four completed features: pada data structure creation, nakshatra engine pada calculation, CurrentNakshatraBanner pada display, and visual indicators for current lunar climate.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, hooks, utilities, and pages, highlighting pada calculation, lunar climate display, and cosmic dark theme implementation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables, with dark theme featuring cosmic aesthetic using purple/violet primary colors and cyan accents.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, 'Star Fields' title, root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, nakshatra detail, and admin pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider (dark mode default) and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/CurrentNakshatra: Banner displaying current nakshatra with Moon icon and expandable pada details section showing navamsa sign, title, degree range, and full interpretive description with accent color emphasis and animated indicators.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with Caffeine.ai attribution link including UTM parameters and dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with Star Fields branding (Moon icon and title) and navigation links to Nakshatras and Admin pages with active state styling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing consistent structure with Header, main content area using React Router Outlet, and Footer in a flex column layout.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraGrid.ts: Displays a responsive grid of all 27 Nakshatras as clickable cards with images, highlighting the current Nakshatra based on moon position and linking to detail pages.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraImageUp: Provides an image upload component with 4:5 aspect ratio validation, preview functionality, and progress tracking for Nakshatra images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous ICP actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentNakshatra.t: Returns the current Nakshatra based on moon position and refreshes it every 5 minutes using the nakshatraEngine utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity management, and status tracking for the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useNakshatraMutations: Exports a mutation hook for updating Nakshatra data via the ICP actor, invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching all Nakshatras or a single Nakshatra by name, ensuring backend initialization before queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a dark-themed color palette using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminEditPage.tsx: Admin page for editing Nakshatra details including image upload, description, deity, symbol, and characteristics with form validation and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that displays all 27 nakshatras in a grid with edit buttons, loading skeletons, and error handling. Links to individual nakshatra edit pages.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page that displays a title, description, the CurrentNakshatraBanner component, and the NakshatraGrid component showing all nakshatras.
frontend/src/pages/NakshatraDetailPage.t: Detail page for individual nakshatras showing image, metadata, current moon status badge, and tabbed content sections. Fetches data from both static engine and backend API.
frontend/src/utils/nakshatraEngine.ts: Core utility defining the 27 nakshatras with degree ranges and calculating current nakshatra/pada based on Moon's ecliptic longitude using Julian Day and astronomical formulas.
frontend/src/utils/padaData.ts: Data structure containing interpretive descriptions for all 108 padas (4 per nakshatra), including degree range, navamsa sign, title, and full descriptive text for lunar climate interpretation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, container settings, extended theme values, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document showing completed features for pada data structure, engine calculations, and banner display, with architectural notes about 108 pada descriptions and lunar climate interpretation.
